name: pi-minimal-mode
description: Inline process summary for Pi: one collapsible disclosure of the last N tool/thought steps (default 6, /process to configure), ctrl+o to expand or collapse, /process-native on|off to hide or show native tool cards, and hides Working/Thinking chrome.
